PROJECT INFORMATION

AIRSENSE 2.0 — AI-Powered Air Quality Dashboard. A school demonstration of how an air-quality dashboard monitors, analyses and explains pollution. Readings are measured live by an ESP32-S3 sensor node (PMS5003 laser particle sensor + DHT22) and refreshed every 5 seconds over WiFi.

  • PM1.0 / PM2.5 / PM10: particles up to 1, 2.5 and 10 micrometres wide. Smaller particles travel deeper into the lungs.
  • AQI: an official index (India: CPCB, 0–500) built from several pollutants. PM2.5 alone is a concentration in µg/m³, not an AQI, so this site does not claim an official AQI.
  • Architecture: ESP32-S3 sensors → WiFi (JSON every 5 s) → shared dataset (saved in this browser) → cards, gauge, graph, advisory, analytics, alerts and AirSense AI.
  • Limitations: low-cost sensors, no calibration against a reference station, not a medical or official tool.
  • Future scope: compare with CPCB stations, train a real forecasting model.

Data source: live readings from the ESP32-S3 sensor node (PMS5003 + DHT22), refreshed every 5 seconds over WiFi. The project reading guide is not an official AQI scale.
